limits: Only the listed source snapshots and cases are qualified; this is not project-wide or all-changed-module sanitizer coverage.

Mandatory filesystem/PID/network namespaces, seccomp and resource cgroups were retained. ASan shadow mapping requires omitting the virtual-address-space limit.
Nano covers ordinary CLI/help/no-terminal branches; unresolved tree-sitter entrypoints were not executed. Every runnable wg fixture explicitly uses BASHWG_DRY=1.
Vi uses ordinary key-file/ex and headless reference drivers, not interactive terminal or full editor conformance. Slabtop uses explicit isolated data or option-only paths, not live counters.
Deferred cases are not passes. Metadata/reference identity observers are excluded from operation totals.
